decisions.reason: The blurb reflow and barcode-clearance change does not alter the title-font requirement. Message 7 separately modifies the title requirement, and that modification is already represented.
The revised blurb correction remains within the existing no-redesign constraint and does not change that requirement's current state.
The source repeats the already-required layered PSD, PDF, and JPG formats without changing them; the blurb modification has no necessary effect on the deliverable-format state.
